entities.name: LCS client identity
entities.description: Information element containing information related to the requestor of the terminating LCS request in the CS domain. Sent by the network when received via SGs interface.

entities.name: Network
entities.description: The network entity that sends the LCS client identity IE when it receives the information via SGs interface.

entities.name: SGs interface
entities.description: Interface between MSC and MME through which the network receives LCS client identity information.

entities.name: Terminating LCS request
entities.description: Location services request initiated towards the UE in the CS domain.

relations.description: Network sends the LCS client identity IE when the information is received via SGs interface.
LCS client identity IE contains information related to the requestor of the terminating LCS request.
Network sends LCS client identity IE only when the information is received via SGs interface.
